article.story: HAMDEN, Conn. -- — Anquan Hill scored 26 points as Sacred Heart beat Quinnipiac 98-91 on Friday. Hill had six rebounds and three blocks for the Pioneers (10-13, 6-6 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Nyle Ralph-Beyer scored 24 points and added eight rebounds. Dashon Gittens shot 6 for 7 (4 for 4 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 19 points. Amarri Monroe finished with 24 points and nine rebounds for the Bobcats (14-9, 7-5). Jaden Zimmerman also scored 24 points, and Grant Randall had 18 points and 16 rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
